title: Codebook-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Structurally Heterogeneous Features
abstract: arXiv:2609.37243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-modal knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher modality to a student modality. Existing feature-level alignment methods typically assume that teacher and student features reside in structurally alignable representation spaces. However, this assumption does not hold when cross-modal features are structurally heterogeneous and lack clear unit-level correspondence, such as 2D spatial visual grids and 1D temporal audio sequences, thereby limiting the applicability of feature-level alignment. To address this challenge, we propose a cross-modal distillation framework that enables effective knowledge transfer across structurally heterogeneous feature spaces via a vector-quantized codebook. Specifically, teacher features are abstracted into a set of vector-form codes regardless of their original feature structure, and the selected codes serve as concept-level anchors for student learning. translated_title: 面向结构异构特征的码本引导跨模态知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 跨模态知识蒸馏是将知识从教师模态传递到学生模态的过程。现有的特征级对齐方法通常假设教师特征和学生特征处于结构上可对齐的表示空间中。然而，当跨模态特征在结构上异构且缺乏清晰的单元级对应关系时，例如2D空间视觉网格和1D时间音频序列，这一假设便不再成立，从而限制了特征级对齐的适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种跨模态蒸馏框架，通过向量量化码本在结构异构的特征空间之间实现有效的知识迁移。具体而言，教师特征被抽象为一组向量形式的码，而不受其原始特征结构的限制，所选择的码作为学生学习的概念级锚点。码的选择由……共同引导
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于向量量化码本的跨模态知识蒸馏框架，将教师特征抽象为向量码作为概念级锚点，从而在教师与学生特征结构异构（如2D视觉网格与1D音频序列）的情况下实现有效的知识迁移。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework based on a vector-quantized codebook, which abstracts teacher features into vector-form codes as concept-level anchors, enabling effective knowledge transfer when teacher and student features are structurally heterogeneous, such as 2D visual grids versus 1D audio sequences.
